html:
Eric Gairy was the labour leader who dominated Grenada from 1951 and led it to independence from Britain in 1974 as its first prime minister.

In 1951 he led a general strike of farm workers, which made him the hero of the island's poor. His party won most elections for the next decades.

In power he grew authoritarian. His gang, the Mongoose Gang, beat opponents, and he spoke at the United Nations about flying saucers. In March 1979, while he was abroad, the New Jewel Movement of Maurice Bishop seized power in the first coup in the English-speaking Caribbean.
sum: Eric Gairy was the labour leader who dominated Grenada from 1951 and led it to independence from Britain in 1974 as its first prime minister.
